2.web: “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.
2.asv: Even to-day is my complaint rebellious: My stroke is heavier than my groaning.

3.web: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!
3.asv: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!

4.web: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
4.asv: I would set my cause in order before him, And fill my mouth with arguments.

5.web: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.
5.asv: I would know the words which he would answer me, And understand what he would say unto me.

6.web: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.
6.asv: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? Nay; but he would give heed unto me.

7.web: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.
7.asv: There the upright might reason with him; So should I be delivered for ever from my judge.

8.web: “If I go east, he is not there; if west, I can’t find him;
8.asv: Behold, I go forward, but he is notthere; And backward, but I cannot perceive him;

9.web: He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.
9.asv: On the left hand, when he doth work, but I cannot behold him; He hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him.

10.web: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I shall come out like gold.
10.asv: But he knoweth the way that I take; When he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

11.web: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned aside.
11.asv: My foot hath held fast to his steps; His way have I kept, and turned not aside.

12.web: I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
12.asv: I have not gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

13.web: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.
13.asv: But he is in onemind, and who can turn him? And what his soul desireth, even that he doeth.

14.web: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.
14.asv: For he performeth that which is appointed for me: And many such things are with him.

15.web: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.
15.asv: Therefore am I terrified at his presence; When I consider, I am afraid of him.

16.web: For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.
16.asv: For God hath made my heart faint, And the Almighty hath terrified me;

17.web: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.
17.asv: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, Neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.
